_comment: SAMPLE turning points - the real rules are not published. Each fires once per companion+character; each change is one step; traits are -2..+2. Trait lines are indexed -2,-1,0,+1,+2 (the 0 line is empty) and written to the companion in the second person. A rule fires when the trust band is at least 'band' and every count in 'counts' (ledger event kinds) has been reached; 'memory' becomes a permanent memory line.

warmth: You keep this one at arm's length.
You are guarded with this one.
You have grown fond of this one.
This one feels like family to you.
openness: You say as little as you can.
You speak freely with this one.
You hide very little from this one.
protectiveness: You let this one take their own risks.
You keep a close eye on this one in a fight.
You would step in front of a blade for this one.
humour: You have no patience for jokes.
You tease this one now and then.
You and this one laugh easily together.
deference: You argue with this one's choices.
You follow this one's lead without a second thought.

elspeth.memory: Somewhere along the road, this one stopped being a stranger.
We have seen a fair bit of the world together now.
I watched this one fall once. I will not watch it again.
